# SI040 — missing-duplicate-check

Filing must reject a duplicate evidence bundle.

## Why

One bundle filed repeatedly floods the feed and burns the validator budget.

## Bad

```python
self.incidents[id] = incident  # no duplicate check
```

## Good

```python
if dup_key in self.recent_hashes:
    raise Exception('DUPLICATE_INCIDENT')
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI040 -- reason
```
